brand.name: Inverex
brand.notes: Inverex Solar Energy (Karachi) solar/hybrid inverter line — Phase 2 entry (category: inverter). AC codes live under data/ac/inverex/ (separate). Lines: NitroX string 3Ph-5G, NitroX hybrid, Veyron II/IV, Axpert King, AEROX, VM-II (Voltronic-class). OEM platforms: Deye (Nitrox) + Voltronic (Veyron/King/AEROX/VM). Yukon II / Veyron II Premium fault tables exist in printed manuals but were not extractable online — documented gap. Official site publishes no fault-table download. Support: +92-21-111-209-988 · info@aptinverex.com · HO 021-32711291 / 0300-0560830. See docs/sources/inverex-inverter.md.
